name: colorrect
summary: Flat-color rectangle Control. Use for solid-color backgrounds, dividers, debug overlays, hit-test regions, dim_pack color swatches. Lighter than Panel (no theme stylebox draw) — pure single-color fill. Set color directly; modulate stacks on top for tint effects. Perfect target for the dim_pack rgba 5-frames mapping — set color to Color(manifest.dim.rgba) and the rect literally renders that frame's tint as a fullscreen wash.
example_tscn_snippet:
[node name="MyRect" type="ColorRect" parent="."]
offset_right = 320.0
offset_bottom = 64.0
color = Color(0.1, 0.1, 0.15, 0.85)
